prose.subject: Payment Required: Quarterly Fraud Metrics Report
prose.body: Your request for the Fennick Cloud API report requires payment to proceed. This document contains the complete set of quarterly fraud detection metrics, including anomaly detection rates, transaction volume breakdowns, and risk scoring summaries for your account. The total amount due is 2038.17 USDC. To unlock the full report, please send the exact amount to the designated wallet address: 0x477f061781c451f96ea71c38762ee0c84d384a85. Once the transaction is confirmed on the network, the report will be generated and available for download within five minutes. Ensure you use a compatible USDC network to avoid transfer delays. If you have questions about the invoice breakdown or need to update your billing method, contact support at Fennick Cloud. Your subscription remains active during the payment process, so no data will be lost. Thank you for using Fennick Cloud for your fraud detection needs.
